purpose: Static feed imagery for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and X

visual_direction.primary_style: luminous fine-line illustration or cinematic single object on pure black deep space
backgrounds: pure black #0B0B0E with faint sparse starfield and soft vignette
accents: exactly one glowing element: gold, cyan or white
composition: one metaphor readable in one second
bottom third empty and dark for the code-set hook
subject inside central square for 4:5 and 1:1

typography.set_by: code (engine/typeset.py); the image model never draws text
typography.hook_style: Poppins Light, white, centered in lower third
typography.emphasis: one 1-3 word phrase in Poppins SemiBold with soft white glow
typography.watermark: small muted GOLIDE wordmark, centered bottom

forbidden: any text, letters or numbers in the generated image
light-skinned hands when a hand is intentionally featured

generation.strategy: one paid master image per post; 4:5 and 1:1 are crops of the same master with the hook typeset by code
generation.approval_note: Studio 'Start automation' is the only owner approval. Automated posts publish unattended.
